species.name: Ring-billed Gull (Adult)
species.plate_caption: Diagnostic plate: Medium build, pale pearl-gray mantle, bright yellow legs, complete solid black bill ring, pale yellow eye
species.photo_caption: Field profile: Crisp black band completely encircling slender yellow bill, bright yellow legs, pale gray mantle
species.crux_caption: Head closeup: Piercing pale yellow iris, complete black subterminal ring, neat head streaking in winter

diagnostics.mark: Slender yellow bill encircled by a sharp, complete solid black ring near the tip (never has a red spot).
Bright yellow to greenish-yellow legs; pale lemon-yellow iris with a subtle red orbital ring.
Pale pearl-gray mantle (slightly paler than Herring Gull); medium build, noticeably smaller and gentler than Herring Gull.

species.rule_out: Slender yellow bill with complete black ring + bright yellow legs + pale gray mantle = Adult Ring-billed Gull.

species.name: Ring-billed Gull (1st Winter)
species.plate_caption: Diagnostic plate: Mottled brown-gray saddle, flesh-pink legs, pink bill with sharply demarcated solid black distal third, narrow black tail band
species.photo_caption: Field profile: Pink base with sharp black tip on bill, neat brown wing covert mottling, pink legs
species.crux_caption: Tail & wings: Crisp narrow black tail band contrasting with white rump; neat pale gray saddle

diagnostics.mark: Distinctive two-toned bill: bright flesh-pink basal two-thirds with a sharply demarcated, solid black tip.
Flesh-pink legs (turn yellowish in 2nd year); narrow, clean black subterminal tail band contrasting with white rump.
Pale gray saddle feathers starting to molt in, surrounded by neatly patterned brown wing coverts.

species.rule_out: Pink bill with crisp black tip + narrow clean black tail band + pink legs = 1st-Winter Ring-billed Gull.

species.name: Herring Gull (Adult Winter)
species.plate_caption: Diagnostic plate: Heavy bulky build, pale pearl-gray mantle, pale pink flesh legs, heavy yellow bill with red gonydeal spot, streaked winter head
species.photo_caption: Field profile: Bulky chest, heavy yellow bill with red gonydeal spot, bubblegum-pink legs, brown-streaked winter nape
species.crux_caption: Bill & eye: Pale clear yellow eye with fierce brow angle; bold red spot on lower mandible angle

diagnostics.mark: Heavy, stout yellow bill with an angular gonys marked by a prominent bright red spot on the lower mandible.
Flesh-pink to bubblegum-pink legs at all seasons (diagnostic versus yellow-legged adult Ring-billed and Lesser Black-backed).
Pale pearl-gray mantle; head and hindneck heavily smudged/streaked with dusky brown in winter plumage.

species.rule_out: Heavy build + pale gray mantle + bubblegum-pink legs + red spot on heavy yellow bill = Adult Herring Gull.

species.name: Herring Gull (1st Winter)
species.plate_caption: Diagnostic plate: Coarse checkered grayish-brown plumage, heavy dark bill, pink legs, uniform dark brown tail and primaries
species.photo_caption: Field profile: Large bulky shape, uniform checkered brown plumage, dark smudgy bill, pink legs
species.crux_caption: Flight/covert pattern: Solid dark brown tail with pale vermiculated uppertail coverts; pale window on inner primaries

diagnostics.mark: Uniformly mottled, checkered grayish-brown all over body, head, and folded wings with no crisp white head contrast.
Heavy all-dark or dusky blackish bill (develops pale pinkish base later in 1st winter); sturdy pink legs.
Broad solid dark brown tail band; in flight shows a distinctive paler translucent window on inner primary feathers.

species.rule_out: Bulky brown gull + heavy dark bill + solid dark brown tail + pale inner primary window = 1st-Winter Herring Gull.

species.name: Great Black-backed Gull (Adult)
species.plate_caption: Diagnostic plate: Massive apex predator build, stark jet-black mantle, pale pink legs, massive dagger-like yellow bill with blood-red spot
species.photo_caption: Field profile: Enormous size, pitch-black mantle contrasting with snow-white underparts, heavy flesh-pink legs
species.crux_caption: Bill closeup: Massive brutal yellow bill with bulbous gonys and deep red spot; pale stern cold eye

diagnostics.mark: World's largest gull; stark slaty-black to jet-black mantle and wings contrasting sharply with snow-white underparts.
Massive, dagger-like yellow bill with a prominent bulbous gonys and blood-red spot; fearsome aggressive expression.
Pale flesh-pink to whitish-pink legs (never bright yellow, instantly separating it from Lesser Black-backed Gull).

species.rule_out: Giant size + jet-black mantle + pale pink legs + massive brutal bill = Adult Great Black-backed Gull.

species.name: Great Black-backed Gull (1st Winter)
species.plate_caption: Diagnostic plate: Massive barrel-chested build, stark white head and chest contrasting with sharply checkered dark mantle, massive black bill
species.photo_caption: Field profile: Huge heavy structure, clean whitish face and chest, crisp dark checkered scapulars, pale pink legs
species.crux_caption: Covert pattern: High-contrast checkered blackish-brown and white feathers; massive heavy black bill

diagnostics.mark: Massive, barrel-chested profile with thick bull-neck, dwarfing nearby Herring and Ring-billed Gulls.
Strikingly white head, throat, and underparts contrasting sharply with dark checkered mantle (much whiter-headed than 1st-winter Herring).
Huge heavy all-black bill (sometimes with slight pale flesh base); finely checkered/barred tail coverts with distinct tail band.

species.rule_out: Massive bull-necked size + strikingly white head/underparts + crisp checkered black-brown mantle = 1st-Winter Great Black-backed Gull.

species.name: Laughing Gull (Adult Breeding)
species.plate_caption: Diagnostic plate: Full velvety black hood, bold white crescent eye-arcs, deep slate-gray mantle, drooping dark red bill, solid black wingtips
species.photo_caption: Field profile: Velvety jet-black hood extending down nape, crisp white eye-crescents, dark slate-gray back
species.crux_caption: Head closeup: Bold separated white eye-arcs above and below dark eye; long drooping dark red bill

diagnostics.mark: Full velvety jet-black hood extending completely over crown, cheeks, and upper nape in spring/summer.
Prominent, thick white crescent eye-arcs above and below dark eye; long, noticeably drooping dark reddish-black bill.
Deep, dark slate-gray mantle (much darker than Herring/Ring-billed); solid black wingtips without white mirrors.

species.rule_out: Full black hood + bold white eye-arcs + deep slate-gray mantle + drooping reddish bill = Breeding Adult Laughing Gull.

species.name: Laughing Gull (Adult Winter)
species.plate_caption: Diagnostic plate: White head with dusky brownish-gray smudge across hindneck and ear coverts, deep slate-gray mantle, drooping blackish bill
species.photo_caption: Field profile: White face with dusky smudge on rear crown and nape, deep slate mantle, long drooping dark bill
species.crux_caption: Resting view: Dark slate-gray back, solid black primary tips lacking white spots, dusky collar

diagnostics.mark: Hood lost; white head with a characteristic dusky, mottled brownish-gray smudge forming a partial collar around rear crown/nape.
Deep charcoal/slate-gray mantle retained year-round; solid black outer primaries without white apical mirror spots.
Long, slender, distinctly decurved (drooping) blackish bill; dark reddish-black legs.

species.rule_out: Deep slate-gray mantle + dusky nape smudge + long drooping dark bill + solid black wingtips = Winter Adult Laughing Gull.

species.name: Bonaparte's Gull (Adult Winter)
species.plate_caption: Diagnostic plate: Petite tern-like build, pale silvery-gray mantle, stark round black ear spot on white head, needle-thin black bill, pink-orange legs
species.photo_caption: Field profile: Dainty petite profile, round black spot behind eye, needle-fine black bill, bright pinkish-orange legs
species.crux_caption: Flight profile: Dazzling long white triangle/wedge on leading edge of outer wing, black trailing edge

diagnostics.mark: Petite, dainty, tern-like structure; snappy, buoyant, flickering wingbeats in flight (smallest common gull in MD).
Clean white head with a prominent, stark round blackish ear spot behind eye; needle-thin, sharp all-black bill.
In flight, shows a brilliant, broad silvery-white triangular wedge across outer primaries with a neat black trailing edge.

species.rule_out: Petite tern-like build + needle-thin black bill + stark black ear spot + bright pink-orange legs = Winter Adult Bonaparte's Gull.

species.name: Bonaparte's Gull (1st Winter)
species.plate_caption: Diagnostic plate: Petite dainty size, black ear spot, needle-thin black bill, bold brown carpal bar forming diagonal wing zigzag, black tail band
species.photo_caption: Field profile: Small dainty build, dark ear spot, brown carpal bar across wing coverts, pinkish-orange legs
species.crux_caption: Flight view: Brown diagonal 'M' pattern across upperwings, clean black subterminal tail band

diagnostics.mark: Distinct dark blackish ear spot on white head; dainty, slender needle-like black bill.
Bold brown carpal bar running diagonally across upperwing coverts, creating a striking zigzag 'M' pattern in flight.
Narrow, crisp black subterminal band across pure white tail; dull flesh-pink to pale orange legs.

species.rule_out: Petite dainty size + slender black bill + black ear spot + brown diagonal wing bar + black tail band = 1st-Winter Bonaparte's Gull.

species.name: Lesser Black-backed Gull (Adult Winter)
species.plate_caption: Diagnostic plate: Slender attenuated build, dark slate-gray mantle (intermediate between Herring and GBBG), bright yellow legs, long wings
species.photo_caption: Field profile: Dark slate mantle, bright butter-yellow legs, long slender wings projecting far past tail, yellow bill with red spot
species.crux_caption: Comparison profile: Charcoal-gray mantle clearly darker than Herring Gull but paler than jet-black Great Black-backed; bright yellow legs

diagnostics.mark: Bright butter-yellow legs in adult (100% diagnostic crux separating it from pink-legged Herring and Great Black-backed Gulls).
Deep slate/charcoal gray mantle (graellsii subspecies) — conspicuously darker than Herring Gull, yet noticeably paler than jet-black Great Black-backed.
Very long, slender, attenuated wings extending far beyond tail tip when standing, imparting an elegant, tapered rear profile.

species.rule_out: Dark slate mantle + bright yellow legs + long primary projection + red spot on yellow bill = Adult Lesser Black-backed Gull.

species.name: Lesser Black-backed Gull (1st Winter)
species.plate_caption: Diagnostic plate: Elongate attenuated structure, very dark uniform blackish-brown wing coverts, solid black slender bill, dark eye mask
species.photo_caption: Field profile: Very dark sooty-brown wing coverts, slender all-black bill, dark eye smudge, elongate silhouette
species.crux_caption: Flight profile: Distinct pale translucent window on inner primaries; broad dark brown-black tail band

diagnostics.mark: Conspicuously dark, sooty blackish-brown wing coverts and tertials (overall darker and more uniform than 1st-winter Herring Gull).
Slender, all-black bill without pale base; dark smudgy 'raccoon' mask concentrated around and behind eye.
Slender, elongate structure with long primary projection extending far past the tail.

species.rule_out: Very dark sooty-brown coverts + slender all-black bill + long primary projection + dark eye mask = 1st-Winter Lesser Black-backed Gull.

species.name: Iceland Gull (Kumlien's Adult)
species.plate_caption: Diagnostic plate: Gentle rounded dove-like head, small dainty greenish-yellow bill with faint red spot, pink legs, frosted pale gray wingtips with NO solid black
species.photo_caption: Field profile: Gentle rounded crown, small petite bill, pale pearl-gray mantle, pale frosted/translucent wingtips
species.crux_caption: Wingtip closeup: Wingtips lack solid black (pale gray markings or white mirrors on frosted gray primaries), small bill

diagnostics.mark: Wingtips completely lack solid jet-black pigment! Show pale gray to frosted translucent primary tips with variable pale gray markings (Kumlien's).
Distinctive gentle, rounded, dove-like head profile with steep forehead; small, delicate greenish-yellow bill with faint red spot.
Medium build (Herring Gull size or slightly smaller, but much more delicate); bright flesh-pink legs.

species.rule_out: Gentle rounded dove-like head + small delicate bill + pale gray/frosted wingtips with NO solid black = Adult Iceland Gull (Kumlien's).

species.name: Iceland Gull (1st Winter)
species.plate_caption: Diagnostic plate: Gentle dove-like rounded head, delicate slender dark bill, pink legs, uniform pale creamy-biscuit plumage, pure frosted wingtips
species.photo_caption: Field profile: Uniform frosted café-au-lait wash, gentle rounded head, delicate slender black-tipped bill, pale wingtips
species.crux_caption: Standing profile: Wingtips as pale as or paler than the body, completely lacking dark brown or black pigment

diagnostics.mark: Uniformly pale creamy-buff, biscuit, or café-au-lait vermiculated plumage all over body and folded wings.
Wingtips are entirely pale and frosted (pure white to creamy-buff), matching or paler than the mantle (never dark brown like Herring Gull!).
Dove-like rounded head with steep forehead; slender, delicate dark bill with pale flesh base; pink legs.

species.rule_out: Frosted creamy-biscuit body + pale wingtips lacking dark pigment + gentle rounded head + petite slender bill = 1st-Winter Iceland Gull.

species.name: Glaucous Gull (Adult Winter)
species.plate_caption: Diagnostic plate: Massive heavy apex size, very pale chalky-gray mantle, heavy stout yellow bill with red gonydeal spot, pink legs, pure white wingtips
species.photo_caption: Field profile: Huge bulky body (rivals Great Black-backed), very pale chalky-gray back, pure chalk-white wingtips with zero black
species.crux_caption: Head closeup: Heavy stout yellow bill with bright red gonydeal spot, pale yellow eye, fierce flat crown

diagnostics.mark: Pure chalk-white wingtips with zero black, gray, or dark pigment anywhere (completely unmarked white primary tips).
Massive, powerful, heavy-chested high-Arctic gull (often exceeds Herring Gull in size, rivaling Great Black-backed Gull).
Heavy, stout yellow bill with a prominent red gonydeal spot; extremely pale, washed-out chalky-gray mantle; pink legs.

species.rule_out: Massive apex size + extremely pale mantle + pure chalk-white wingtips with zero black + heavy yellow bill = Adult Glaucous Gull.

species.name: Glaucous Gull (1st Winter)
species.plate_caption: Diagnostic plate: Massive heavy structure, pale creamy-white to buff wash, pure white wingtips, heavy pink bill with sharply demarcated black tip
species.photo_caption: Field profile: Huge size, pale creamy-buff plumage, pure white wingtips, distinctive heavy two-toned pink-and-black bill
species.crux_caption: Bill closeup: Bright bubblegum-pink basal two-thirds with a razor-sharp, ink-black tip; sturdy pink legs

diagnostics.mark: Diagnostic two-toned bill: bright flesh-pink basal two-thirds with a razor-sharp, completely demarcated jet-black distal tip.
Pure snow-white to pale creamy-buff wingtips (zero dark brown or black pigment); uniform pale marzipan-buff body plumage.
Massive heavy-chested apex structure with a flat, fierce crown and thick bull-neck; pale flesh-pink legs.

species.rule_out: Massive size + pure white wingtips + heavy two-toned pink-and-black bill = 1st-Winter Glaucous Gull.

species.name: Black-headed Gull (Adult Winter)
species.plate_caption: Diagnostic plate: Medium-small size (larger than Bonaparte's), pale gray mantle, dark ear spot, dull dark red bill and legs, dark underwing primaries
species.photo_caption: Field profile: White head with dark smudged ear spot, dull dark reddish bill with dusky tip, dull red legs
species.crux_caption: Crux flight view: Diagnostic dark charcoal/blackish underside of primaries (Bonaparte's has snow-white underwings!)

diagnostics.mark: 100% DIAGNOSTIC CRUX: In flight, underside of primary flight feathers is solid smoky charcoal-gray to black (Bonaparte's has pure white underwing!).
Dull dark reddish to blood-red bill with a dusky/blackish tip; dull dark red legs (Bonaparte's has needle-thin black bill and bright pinkish-orange legs).
Noticeably larger, longer-winged, and heavier-billed than Bonaparte's Gull; white head with dark dusky ear spot.

species.rule_out: Bonaparte's lookalike with dark smoky-black underwing + dull reddish bill + dull red legs = Adult Black-headed Gull.

species.name: Black-legged Kittiwake (Adult Winter)
species.plate_caption: Diagnostic plate: Compact oceanic pelagic gull, medium-gray mantle, plain unmarked greenish-yellow bill, very short jet-black legs, solid ink-dipped wingtips
species.photo_caption: Field profile: Plain unmarked pale greenish-yellow bill, very short jet-black legs, solid triangular black wingtips without white spots
species.crux_caption: Flight wingtips: Wingtips look cleanly dipped into black ink, cut off straight across with NO white mirrors or spots

diagnostics.mark: Solid triangular jet-black wingtips that look neatly dipped into black ink, severed straight across with ZERO white mirror spots.
Very short, jet-black legs (tridactyla lacks hind toe); plain, unmarked pale greenish-yellow bill (no red spot, no black ring).
Dusky slate-gray smudge across hindneck/nape; pelagic oceanic cliff gull seen offshore or driven to coast during major nor'easters.

species.rule_out: Plain greenish-yellow bill + short jet-black legs + ink-dipped wingtips with no white mirrors = Adult Black-legged Kittiwake.

species.name: Black-legged Kittiwake (1st Winter)
species.plate_caption: Diagnostic plate: Compact pelagic gull, all-black bill, short black legs, bold black 'tar collar' nape bar, carpal wing zigzag, black tail band
species.photo_caption: Field profile: Bold black collar across back of neck ('tar collar'), black ear spot, all-black bill, short black legs
species.crux_caption: Flight pattern: Striking bold black 'M' zigzag across upperwings, clean black subterminal tail band, solid black outer primaries

diagnostics.mark: Diagnostic stark black bar or half-collar across the hindneck ('tar collar'), accompanied by a crisp black ear spot.
Bold, dramatic black diagonal 'M' or zigzag band across upperwing coverts contrasting with pure white trailing secondary triangle.
Stout, all-black bill; short jet-black legs; neat black terminal band on notched white tail.

species.rule_out: Black 'tar collar' on nape + bold black 'M' zigzag on upperwing + solid black bill + short black legs = 1st-Winter Black-legged Kittiwake.
